CLOUD FIXER seat for PR #2411 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer (R10-SAV-BASELINE, branch fix/r10-sav-baseline), head 74d66b3554a9381c68190424b96cb262ffd6c295. Never send push notifications.
Required check `mutation` is red at this head (jobs 117738322488 and 117738310043 in runs 39148893518 / 39148888366) and `nightly-ha (stable)` is red (job 117738343906). Read the job logs (gh run view --log-failed) and the mutation-autofix summary first (ci-autofix.md: wait for a bot commit only when it says changed). Fix the mutation red soundly (pin or kill the survivor with a real test; never triage a killable mutant). For nightly-ha: establish whether this diff can reach it; if not, say so in `## Red checks` with the evidence (a root-cause seat is analysing the recurring py-spy timeout separately).
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. Toolchain is on PATH. Run heavy jobs in the background with Monitor. Run tests/entities.py with `env -u BASH_ENV`.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from origin/main and follow them exactly. Merge origin/main, never rebase. Re-execute steps 2-8 and re-take the body in full; answer every red check in `## Red checks`.
Return: push code to `handoff/r10-sav-baseline` (fast-forward) and the body via tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh to `handoff-body/r10-sav-baseline`. Push nothing else; do not open, edit, comment on or merge any PR. A fixer writes no delivery row. No host paths in any text. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it. End with CODE=<sha> BODY=<sha>.
